title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: filter responses by content source
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, default, licensing and federated connector controls are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. The statement that users see connector health in the selector needs narrowing: Microsoft describes missing unhealthy connectors, not a health display. Two small governance corrections remain.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; controls[0].api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No tenant UI switch or automation to turn this content source selector on or off is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat content source filters tenant disable selector admin switch API. Opened Configure Microsoft Copilot settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center and Manage Copilot Chat; neither documents a selector-specific switch.

claims.claim: Publisher-type availability is managed in Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access. Clear the publisher types you want to block:
claims.fix: The path reaches the correct page but stops before the deciding checkbox. Set controls[1].ui.path to 'Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access > publisher type'. In its note, name the choices: 'Allow agents and plugins built by Microsoft', 'Allow agents and plugins built by your organization', and 'Allow agents and plugins built by external publishers', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/connectors/manage-federated-connectors.

claims.claim: No automation for the Agent and plugin access publisher-type setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "Agent and plugin access"; Microsoft Graph beta API Agent and plugin access User access federated connectors staged rollout settings. Opened Agent settings and Manage federated connector availability; found UI controls, not an equivalent operation.

claims.quote: Specific users or groups | Only these users can use any connector. Connector staging can narrow but not widen this population.
